G2384.def:
**Ἰακώβ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. יַעֲקֹב),
**Jacob**;
1. **The patriarch**: [[Mat.1.2; 8.11|Mat.1:2 8:11]], [[Jhn.4.5-6|Jhn.4:5-6]], [[Act.7.8|Act.7:8]], al; as in _Heb._ (cf. [[Num.23.7|Num.23:7]], [[Isa.41.8|Isa.41:8]], [[Sir.23.12|Sir.23:12]], al.), of his descendants, [[Rom.11.26|Rom.11:26]] (LXX).
2. **The father-in-law of Mary**: [[Mat.1.15-16|Mat.1:15-16]] (on the form as distinct from that of the next word, see Deiss., BS, 3161)
(AS)

G2309.def:
**θέλω** (the strengthened form ἐθέλω is found in Hom., and is the more frequently in Attic; see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 415f.),
[in LXX for חפץ ,אבה; with neg., מאן pi., etc. ;]
**to will, be willing, wish, desire** (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., [[Rom.9.16|Rom.9:16]], [[1Co.4.19; 12.18|1Co.4:19 12:18]], [[Jas.4.15|Jas.4:15]]; τ. θεοῦ θέλοντος, [[Act.18.21|Act.18:21]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.20.21|Mat.20:21]], [[Mrk.14.36|Mrk.14:36]], [[Jhn.15.7|Jhn.15:7]], [[Rom.7.15, 16|Rom.7:15, 16]] [[1Co.4.21; 7.36|1Co.4:21 7:36]], [[Gal.5.17|Gal.5:17]]; with inf., [[Mat.5.40|Mat.5:40]], [[Mrk.10.43|Mrk.10:43]], [[Jhn.6.21, 67|Jhn.6:21, 67]] [[Rom.7.21|Rom.7:21]], [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]]; with accusative and inf., [[Mrk.7.24|Mrk.7:24]], [[Luk.1.62|Luk.1:62]], [[Jhn.21.22, 23|Jhn.21:22, 23]] [[Rom.16.19|Rom.16:19]], [[1Co.14.5|1Co.14:5]], [[Gal.6.13|Gal.6:13]]; οὐ θέλω, [[Mat.18.30|Mat.18:30]], al.; id. with inf., [[Mat.2.18|Mat.2:18]], [[Mrk.6.26|Mrk.6:26]], [[Jhn.5.40|Jhn.5:40]], [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]]; before ἵνα, [[Mat.7.12|Mat.7:12]], [[Mrk.6.25|Mrk.6:25]], [[Jhn.17.24|Jhn.17:24]]; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, [[Rom.7.15, 19|Rom.7:15, 19]] [[2Co.8.10, 11|2Co.8:10, 11]] [[Php.2.13|Php.2:13]]; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., _LAE_, 179:24), [[1Co.14.19|1Co.14:19]] θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (**of his own mere will, by humility**, R, mg), [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]] in OT quotations, for Heb. חפץ, with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.9.13; 12.7|Mat.9:13 12:7]], [[Heb.10.5|Heb.10:5]], 8; with inf., [[1Pe.3.10|1Pe.3:10]] for אמר, with inf., [[Act.7.28|Act.7:28]] (see Cremer, 726ff.).
**θέλω** (the strengthened form ἐθέλω is found in Hom., and is the more frequently in Attic; see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 415f.),
[in LXX for חפץ ,אבה; with neg., מאן pi., etc. ;]
**to will, be willing, wish, desire** (more frequently than βούλομαι, which see, in vernac. and late Gk., also in MGr.; for various views as to its relation to β., see Thayer, 286; but see also BL, §24, see word): absol., [[Rom.9.16|Rom.9:16]], [[1Co.4.19; 12.18|1Co.4:19 12:18]], [[Jas.4.15|Jas.4:15]]; τ. θεοῦ θέλοντος, [[Act.18.21|Act.18:21]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.20.21|Mat.20:21]], [[Mrk.14.36|Mrk.14:36]], [[Jhn.15.7|Jhn.15:7]], [[Rom.7.15, 16|Rom.7:15, 16]] [[1Co.4.21; 7.36|1Co.4:21 7:36]], [[Gal.5.17|Gal.5:17]]; with inf., [[Mat.5.40|Mat.5:40]], [[Mrk.10.43|Mrk.10:43]], [[Jhn.6.21, 67|Jhn.6:21, 67]] [[Rom.7.21|Rom.7:21]], [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]]; with accusative and inf., [[Mrk.7.24|Mrk.7:24]], [[Luk.1.62|Luk.1:62]], [[Jhn.21.22, 23|Jhn.21:22, 23]] [[Rom.16.19|Rom.16:19]], [[1Co.14.5|1Co.14:5]], [[Gal.6.13|Gal.6:13]]; οὐ θέλω, [[Mat.18.30|Mat.18:30]], al.; id. with inf., [[Mat.2.18|Mat.2:18]], [[Mrk.6.26|Mrk.6:26]], [[Jhn.5.40|Jhn.5:40]], [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]]; before ἵνα, [[Mat.7.12|Mat.7:12]], [[Mrk.6.25|Mrk.6:25]], [[Jhn.17.24|Jhn.17:24]]; opposite to ποιέω, πράσσω, ἐνεργέω, [[Rom.7.15, 19|Rom.7:15, 19]] [[2Co.8.10, 11|2Co.8:10, 11]] [[Php.2.13|Php.2:13]]; before ἤ (ICG, in l.; Deiss., _LAE_, 179:24), [[1Co.14.19|1Co.14:19]] θέλων ἐν ταπεινοφροσυνῄ (**of his own mere will, by humility**, R, mg), [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]] in OT quotations, for Heb. חפץ, with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.9.13; 12.7|Mat.9:13 12:7]], [[Heb.10.5|Heb.10:5]], 8; with inf., [[1Pe.3.10|1Pe.3:10]] for אמר, with inf., [[Act.7.28|Act.7:28]] (see Cremer, 726ff.).
(AS)

G2316.def:
**θεός**, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ ([[Act.19.37|Act.19:37]] only; see M, _Pr._, 60, 244), late voc., θεέ ([[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]] cf. [[Deu.3.24|Deu.3:24]], al.),
[in LXX chiefly for אֱלֹהִים, also for אֵל and other cognate forms, יהוה, etc. ;]
**a god or deity, God**.
1. In polytheistic sense, **a god** or **deity**: [[Act.28.6|Act.28:6]], [[1Co.8.4|1Co.8:4]], [[2Th.2.4|2Th.2:4]], al.; pl., [[Act.14.11; 19.26|Ac. 14:11 19:26]], [[Gal.4.8|Gal.4:8]], al.
2. Of the one true **God**;
(a) **anarthrous**: [[Mat.6.24|Mat.6:24]], [[Luk.20.38|Luk.20:38]], al.; esp. with prep. (Kühner 3, iii, 605), ἀπὸ θ., [[Jhn.3.2|Jhn.3:2]] ἐκ, [[Act.5.39|Act.5:39]], [[2Co.5.1|2Co.5:1]], [[Php.3.9|Php.3:9]]; ὑπό, [[Rom.13.1|Rom.13:1]] παρὰ θεοῦ, [[Jhn.1.6|Jhn.1:6]] παρὰ θεῷ, [[2Th.1.6|2Th.1:6]], [[1Pe.2.4|1Pe.2:4]]; κατὰ θεόν, [[Rom.8.27|Rom.8:27]], [[2Co.7.9, 10|2Co.7:9, 10]]; also when in genitive dependent on an anarth. noun (Bl., §46, 6), [[Mat.27.43|Mat.27:43]], [[Luk.3.2|Luk.3:2]], [[Rom.1.17|Rom.1:17]], [[1Th.2.13|1Th.2:13]]; as pred., [[Luk.20.38|Lk 20:38]], [[Jhn.1.1|Jhn.1:1]], and when the nature and character rather than the person of God is meant, [[Act.5.29|Act.5:29]], [[Gal.2.6|Gal.2:6]], al. (M, _Th._, 14);
(b) more freq., with art.: [[Mat.1.23|Mat.1:23]], [[Mrk.2.7|Mrk.2:7]], al. mult.; with prep., ἀπὸ τ. θ., [[Luk.1.26|Luk.1:26]] ἐκ, [[Jhn.8.42|Jhn.8:42]], al.; παρὰ τοῦ θ., [[Jhn.8.40|Jhn.8:40]] π. τῷ θ., [[Rom.9.14|Rom.9:14]] ἐν, [[Col.3.3|Col.3:3]] ἐπὶ τῷ θ., [[Luk.1.47|Luk.1:47]] ἐπὶ τὸν θ., [[Act.15.19|Act.15:19]] εἰς τ. θ., [[Act.24.15|Act.24:15]] πρὸς τ. θ., [[Jhn.1.2|Jhn.1:2]] with genitive of person(s), [[Mat.22.32|Mat.22:32]], [[Mrk.12.26, 27|Mrk.12:26, 27]], [[Luke.20.37|Luk.20:37]], [[Jhn.20.17|Jhn.20:17]], al.; ὁ θ. μου, [[Rom.1.8|Rom.1:8]], [[Php.1.3|Php 1:3]], al.; ὁ θ. καὶ πατήρ κ. τ. λ., [[Rom.15.6|Rom.15:6]], [[Eph.1.3|Eph.1:3]], [[Php.4.20|Phi 4:20]], al.; with genitive of thing(s), [[Rom.15.5, 13, 33|Rom.15:5, 13, 33]], [[2Co.1.3|2Co.1:3]], [[1Th.5.23|1Th.5:23]]; τὰ τ. θεοῦ, [[Mat.16.23|Mat.16:23]], [[Mrk.12.17|Mrk.12:17]], [[1Co.2.11|1Co.2:11]]; τὰ πρὸς τὸν θ., [[Rom.15.17|Rom.15:17]], [[Heb.2.17; 5.1|Heb.2:17 5:1]]; τ. θεῷ, as a superl. (LXX, [[Jos.3.3|Jos.3:3]]), [[Act.7.20|Act.7:20]], [[2Co.10.4|2Co.10:4]]; Hebraistically, of judges (Psa.81(82):6), [[Jhn.10.34|Jhn.10:34]]" (LXX), 35.
(AS)

G2344.def:
**θησαυρός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(τίθημι), [in LXX chiefly for אוֹצָר ;]
1. **a place of safe keeping**;
(a) **a casket**: [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]]
(b) a treasury ([[1Ma.3.29|1Ma.3:29]] and frequently in cl.);
(with) a storehouse ([[Neh.13.12|Neh.13:12]], [[Deu.28.12|Deu.28:12]], al.): [[Mat.13.52|Mat.13:52]]; metaphorically, of the soul, [[Mat.12.35|Mat.12:35]] τ. καρδίας, [[Luk.6.45|Luk.6:45]]
2. **a treasure**: [[Mat.6.18-21; 13.44|Mat.6:18-21 13:44]], [[Luk.12.33-34|Luk.12:33-34]], [[Heb.11.26|Heb.11:26]]; θ. ἐν οὐρανῷ (see Dalman, _Words_, 206 ff.), [[Mat.19.21|Mat.19:21]], [[Mrk.10.21|Mrk.10:21]], [[Luk.18.22|Luk.18:22]]; of the knowledge of God through Christ, [[2Co.4.7|2Co.4:7]] τ. σοφίας κ. γνώσεως, [[Col.2.3|Col.2:3]]†
(AS)

G2373.def:
**θυμόω**, -ῶ
(θυμός) [in LXX (chiefly in pass.) for חָרָה, אַף חָרָה hith., etc. ;] (no act. in Attic.);
pass. (and mid.),
**to be wroth or very angry**: [[Mat.2.16|Mat.2:16]]†
(AS)

G2348.def:
**θνήσκω **
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
**to die**; pf. (M, _Pr._, 114), **to be dead**: [[Mat.2.20|Mat.2:20]], [[Mrk.15.44|Mrk.15:44]], [[Luk.7.12; 8.49|Luk.7:12 8:49]], [[Jhn.11.44; 19.33|Jhn.11:44 19:33]], [[Act.14.19; 25.19|Act.14:19 25:19]]; metaphorically, of spiritual death, [[1Ti.5.6|1Ti.5:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-απο-θνήσκω).†
(AS)

G2385.def:
**Ἰάκωβος**, -ου, ὁ (Heb., see previous word)
**James**;
1. **Son of Zebedee**: [[Mat.4.21|Mat.4:21]], [[Mrk.1.19, 29|Mrk.1:19, 29]], [[Act.1.13; 12.2|Act.1:13 12:2]], al.
2. **Son of Alphæus**: [[Mat.10.3|Mat.10:3]], [[Mrk.2.14|Mrk.2:14]], al.; commonly identified with Ἰ. ὁ μικρός, James the little, son of Mary (see: Μαρία, 3; Κλωπᾶς), [[Mat.27.56|Mat.27:56]], [[Mrk.15.40; 16.1|Mrk.15:40 16:1]] (cf. [[Jhn.19.25|Jhn.19:25]]).
3. **The Lord's brother **(see: ἀδελφός): [[Mat.13.55|Mat.13:55]], [[Mrk.6.3|Mrk.6:3]], [[Act.12.17|Act.12:17]], al., [[1Co.15.7|1Co.15:7]] (probably), [[Gal.1.19; 2.9, 12|Gal.1:19 2:9, 12]], [[Jas.1.1|Jas.1:1]], [[Jude.1|Ju 1]].
4. **The father of the apostle, Ἰούδας Ἰακώβου**: [[Luk.6.16|Luk.6:16]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]]
(AS)

G2323.def:
**θεραπεύω **
[in LXX for יָשַׁב, etc. ;]
1. **to do service, serve**: with accusative of person(s), pass., [[Act.17.25|Act.17:25]]
2. As medical term, to treat (MM, _Exp._, xv), **cure, heal**: [[Mat.12.10|Mat.12:10]], [[Mrk.6.5|Mrk.6:5]], [[Luk.6.7|Luk.6:7]], al.; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.4.24|Mat.4:24]], [[Mrk.1.34|Mrk.1:34]], al.; before ἀπό, [[Luk.5.15; 6.18; 7.21; 8.2, 43|Luk.5:15 6:18 7:21 8:2, 43]]; θ. νόσον (μαλακίαν), [[Mat.4.23|Mat.4:23]], al
**SYN**: ἰάομαι (see Field, _Notes_, 60; MM, _Exp._, l.with)
(AS)

G2379.def:
**θυσιαστήριον**, -ου, τό
(θυσιάζω, to sacrifice), [in LXX (where the word first appears) very freq., nearly always for מַדְבַּח ;]
**an altar**:
(a) generally, [[Jas.2.21|Jas.2:21]] pl., [[Rom.11.3|Rom.11:3]] (LXX); metaphorically, [[Heb.13.10|Heb.13:10]] (see Westc., in l, and esp. his add, note on the history of the word, 455 ff.);
(b) of the altar of burnt-offering in the Temple, [[Mat.5.23-24; 23.18-20, 35|Mat.5:23-24 23:18-20, 35]], [[Luk.11.51|Luk.11:51]], [[1Co.9.13; 10.18|1Co.9:13 10:18]], [[Heb.7.13|Heb.7:13]], [[Rev.11.1|Rev.11:1]];
(with) of the altar of incense in the sanctuary ([[Exo.30.1|Exo.30:1]], al.), [[Luk.1.11|Luk.1:11]]; symbolically in Heaven, [[Rev.6.9; 8.3; 9.13; 14.18; 16.7|Rev.6:9 8:3 9:13 14:18 16:7]] (Cremer, 292).†
(AS)

G2362.def:
**θρόνος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּסֵּא, [[Exo.11.5|Exo.11:5]], al. ;]
in Hom., a seat, chair. Later, a throne, chair of state, seat of authority; of kings: metaphorically, of God, [[Mat.5.34|Mat.5:34]], [[Act.7.49|Act.7:49]]" (LXX), [[Rev.1.4|Rev.1:4]], al.; by meton., for kingly power, sovereignty, [[Luk.1.32, 52|Luk.1:32, 52]], [[Act.2.30|Act.2:30]]; for an angelic hierarchy, [[Col.1.16|Col.1:16]] of Christ, [[Mat.19.28|Mat.19:28]], [[Rev.3.21|Rev.3:21]], al.; of Satan, [[Rev.2.13|Rev.2:13]] τ. θηρίου, [[Rev.16.10|Rev.16:10]] of the Apostles, [[Mat.19.28|Mat.19:28]], [[Luk.22.30|Luk.22:30]], cf. [[Rev.20.4|Rev.20:4]] of πρεσβύτεροι, [[Rev.4.4; 11.16|Rev.4:4 11:16]] (on θ. τῆς χάριτος, [[Heb.4.16|Heb.4:16]], see Westc., in l; Deiss., BS, 135)
(AS)

G2300.def:
**θεάομαι**, -ῶμαι
[in LXX; [[2Ch.22.6|2Ch.22:6]] (רָאָה), [[Tob.2.2; 13.6, 14|Tob.2:2 13:6, 14]], [[Jdt.15.8|Jdth.15:8]], [[2Ma.2.4|2Ma.2:4]] [[2Mac.3.36|2Mac 3:36]], [[3Ma.5.47|3Ma.5:47]] * ;]
to behold, look upon, contemplate, view (in early writers with a sense of wondering), in NT apparently always in literal, physical sense of "careful and deliberate vision which interprets . . . its object": with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.11.7|Mat.11:7]], [[Luk.7.24; 23.55|Luk.7:24 23:55]], [[Jhn.1.14, 32; 4.35; 11.45|Jhn.1:14, 32 4:35 11:45]], [[Act.22.9|Act.22:9]], [[1Jn.1.1|1Jn.1:1]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.22.11|Mat.22:11]], [[Act.21.27|Act.21:27]], [[Rom.15.24|Rom.15:24]], [[1Jn.4.12|1Jn.4:12]]; with ptcp., [[Mrk.16.14|Mrk.16:14]], [[Luk.5.27|Luk.5:27]], [[Jhn.1.38|Jhn.1:38]], [[Act.1.11|Act.1:11]]; before ὅτι, [[Jhn.6.5|Jhn.6:5]], [[1Jn.4.14|1Jn.4:14]]; pass., [[Mat.6.1; 23.5|Mat.6:1 23:5]], [[Mrk.16.11|Mrk.16:11]].†
_SYN._: see: θεωρέω (AS)

G2374.def:
**θύρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, also for דַּל, דֶּלֶת, etc. ;]
**a door**: κλείειν (ἀποκ-) τὴν θ., [[Mat.6.6|Mat.6:6]], [[Luk.13.25|Luk.13:25]]; pass., [[Mat.25.10|Mat.25:10]], [[Luk.11.7|Luk.11:7]], [[Jhn.20.19, 26|Jhn.20:19, 26]], [[Act.21.30|Act.21:30]]; ἀνοίγειν, [[Act.5.19|Act.5:19]] pass., [[Act.16.26-27;|Act.16:26-27]] κρούειν, [[Act.12.13|Act.12:13]] διὰ τῆς θ., [[Jhn.10.1-2;|Jhn.10:1-2]] πρὸς τὴν θ., [[Mrk.1.33; 11.4|Mrk.1:33 11:4]] (WH om. τήν), [[Act.3.2|Act.3:2]] τὰ πρὸς τὴν θ., the space by the door, [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]] πρὸς τῇ θ., [[Jhn.18.16|Jhn.18:16]] ἐπὶ τῇ θ, [[Act.5.9|Act.5:9]] πρὸ τῆς θ., [[Act.12.6|Act.12:6]] ἐπὶ τῶν θ., [[Act.5.23|Act.5:23]] ἡ θ. τ. μνημείου, [[Mat.27.60|Mat.27:60]], [[Mrk.15.46; 16.3|Mrk.15:46 16:3]]. Metaphorical, of Christ, ἡ θ. τ. προβάτων, [[Jhn.10.7|Jhn.10:7]], 9; of the Kingdom of Heaven, [[Luk.13.24|Luk.13:24]] of opportunities, θ. πίστεως, [[Act.14.27|Act.14:27]] θ. μεγάλη, [[1Co.16.9|1Co.16:9]] θ. τ. λόγου, [[Col.4.3|Col.4:3]] θ. ἀνεῳγμένη (ἠνεῳγ-), [[2Co.2.12|2Co.2:12]], [[Rev.3.8; 4.1|Rev.3:8 4:1]]; of Christ, ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τὴν θ. καὶ κρούων, [[Rev.3.20|Rev.3:20]] of his second coming, ἐπὶ θύραις εἶναι, [[Mat.24.33|Mat.24:33]], [[Mrk.13.29|Mrk.13:29]]; πρὸ θυρῶν ἑστηκέναι, [[Jas.5.9|Jas.5:9]]†
(AS)

G2343.def:
**θησαυρίζω **
[in LXX for צָפַן, etc. ;]
**to lay up, store up**: of riches, [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]] id. with dative of person(s), [[Luk.12.21|Luk.12:21]], [[2Co.12.14|2Co.12:14]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.16.2|1Co.16:2]] θησαυροὺς ἑαυτῷ, [[Mat.6.19-20;|Mat.6:19-20]] pass., [[2Pe.3.7|2Pe.3:7]] metaphorically, ὀργὴν ἑαντῷ, [[Rom.2.5|Rom.2:5]] (cf. [[Pro.1.18|Pro.1:18]], Pss. [[PSS.9.9|Pss.Sol 9:9]]).†
(AS)

G2346.def:
**θλίβω **
[in LXX chiefly (ὁ θλίβων, ) for צוּר ;]
**to press**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.3.9|Mrk.3:9]] ὁδὸς τεθλιμμένη, a narrow (compressed) way, [[Mat.7.14|Mat.7:14]] Metaphorical (as frequently in LXX), **to oppress, afflict, distress**: with accusative of person(s), [[2Th.1.6|2Th.1:6]] pass. (Vg., tribulor, tribulation em patior), [[2Co.1.6; 4.8; 7.5|2Co.1:6 4:8 7:5]], [[1Th.3.4|1Th.3:4]], [[2Th.1.7|2Th.1:7]], [[1Ti.5.10|1Ti.5:10]], [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-θλίβω).†
(AS)

G2311.def:
**θεμελιόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַד ;]
**to lay the foundation of, to found**: with accusative, τ. γῆν, [[Heb.1.10|Heb.1:10]] (LXX); pass., [[Mat.7.25|Mat.7:25]], [[Luk.6.48|Luk.6:48]]; metaphorically, [[1Pe.5.10|1Pe.5:10]] (R, mg., settle); pass., [[Eph.3.18|Eph.3:18]], [[Col.1.23|Col.1:23]].†
(AS)

G2395.def:
**ἰατρός**, -οὔ, ὁ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX for רָפָא ;]
**a physician**: [[Mat.9.12|Mat.9:12]], [[Mrk.2.17; 5.26|Mrk.2:17 5:26]], [[Luk.4.23; 5.31; 8.43|Luk.4:23 5:31 8:43]] (om. WH, R, mg.), [[Col.4.14|Col.4:14]] (on the status of physicians, see MM, _Exp._, xv.).†
(AS)

G2378.def:
**θυσία**, -ας, ἡ
(θύω) [in LXX chiefly for מִנְחָה, זָבַח ;]
1. actively, an offering, sacrifice (Hdt., al.)
2. **Objectively, that which is offered, a sacrifice**: [[Mat.9.13; 12.7|Mat.9:13 12:7]]" (LXX), [[Mrk.9.49|Mrk.9:49]] (WH, mg.), [[Eph.5.2|Eph.5:2]], [[Heb.10.5, 26|Heb.10:5, 26]]; pl. (as usually in cl.), [[Mrk.12.33|Mrk.12:33]], [[Luk.13.1|Luk.13:1]], [[Heb.9.23; 10.1, 8|Heb.9:23 10:1, 8]], (θ. καὶ προσφοράς); θ. ἀνάγειν, [[Act.7.41|Act.7:41]] ἀναφέρειν, [[Heb.7.27|Heb.7:27]] προσφέρειν, [[Act.7.42|Act.7:42]], [[Heb.5.1; 8.3|Heb.5:1 8:3]] (δῶρά τε καὶ θ.) [[Heb.10.11-12; 11.4|Heb.10:11-12 11:4]]; δοῦναι, [[Luk.2.24|Luk.2:24]] pass., [[Heb.9.9|Heb.9:9]] διὰ τῆς θ. αὐτοῦ, [[Heb.9.26|Heb.9:26]] ἐσθίειν τὰς θ. ([[Lev.7.15|Lev.7:15]] ff) [[1Co.10.18|1Co.10:18]] Metaphorical, [[Php.4.18|Php.4:18]], [[Heb.13.16|Heb.13:16]]; θ. πνευματικαί, [[1Pe.2.5|1Pe.2:5]] θ. ζῶσα, [[Rom.12.1|Rom.12:1]] θ. αἰνέσεως, [[Heb.13.15|Heb.13:15]] θ. . . . τ. πίστεως, [[Php.2.17|Php.2:17]]†
(AS)

G2350.def:
**θορυβέω**, -ῶ
(θόρυβος), [in LXX: [[Nam.2.3|Nam.2:3]] (רָעַל ho.), Dan LXX 8:17 (בָּעַת ni.), [[Jdg.3.26|Jdg.3:26]], [[Wis.18.19|Wis.18:19]], [[Sir.40.6|Sir.40:6]] * ;]
1. **to make a noise or uproar**: mid., of loud and ostentatious lamentation, [[Mat.9.23|Mat.9:23]], [[Mrk.5.39|Mrk.5:39]], [[Act.20.10|Act.20:10]].
2. Trans., **to trouble, throw into confusion**: τ. πόλιν, [[Act.17.5|Act.17:5]]†
(AS)

G2326.def:
**θερισμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(θερίζω), [in LXX chiefly for קָצִיר ;]
**harvest**;
(a) **the act**: [[Jhn.4.35|Jhn.4:35]]
(b) **the time**: fig., [[Mat.13.30, 39|Mat.13:30, 39]], [[Mrk.4.29|Mrk.4:29]]
(with) **the crop**: figuratively, [[Mat.9.37-38|Mat.9:37-38]], [[Luk.10.2|Luk.10:2]], [[Rev.14.15|Rev.14:15]].†
(AS)

G2354.def:
**θρηνέω**, -ῶ
(θρῆνος), [in LXX chiefly for יָלַל hi., also for קַיִן pit., etc. ;]
1. intrans., **to lament, wail**: [[Mat.11.17|Mat.11:17]], [[Luk.7.32|Luk.7:32]], [[Jhn.16.20|Jhn.16:20]].
2. Trans., **to bewail**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.23.27|Luk.23:27]]†
_SYN._: κλαίω, κόπτομαι, λυπέομαι, πενθέω (see Tr., _Syn._, lxv). (AS)

G2347.def:
**θλίψις** (LTr., θλῖψις), -εως, ἡ
(θλίβω), [in LXX for צָרָה, etc. ;]
pressure (Arist.). In LXX and NT metaphorically, **tribulation, affliction, distress**: [[Mat.24.9, 21; 24.29|Mat.24:9, 21 24:29]], [[Mrk.13.19, 24|Mrk.13:19, 24]], [[Jhn.16.21|Jhn.16:21]], [[Act.7.11; 11.19|Act.7:11 11:19]], [[Rom.12.12|Rom.12:12]], [[2Co.1.4; 1.8; 4.17; 6.4; 7.4; 8.2; 8.13|2Co.1:4 1:8 4:17 6:4 7:4 8:2 8:13]], [[Php.4.14|Php.4:14]], [[2Th.1.6|2Th.1:6]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]], [[Rev.1.9; 2.9, 22; 7.14|Rev.1:9 2:9, 22 7:14]]; with ἀνάγκη (which see), [[1Th.3.7|1Th.3:7]] στενοχωρία (which from the order of the words would appear to be the stronger term), [[Rom.2.9; 8.35|Rom.2:9 8:35]]; διωγμός, [[Mat.13.21|Mat.13:21]], [[Mrk.4.17|Mrk.4:17]], [[2Th.1.4|2Th.1:4]]; θ. ἔχω, [[Jhn.16.33|Jhn.16:33]], [[1Co.7.23|1Co.7:23]], [[Rev.2.10|Rev.2:10]]; ἔρχεσθαι ἐπί, [[Act.7.11|Act.7:11]] ἐν θλίψει [[1Th.1.6|1Th.1:6]] pl., [[Act.7.10; 14.22; 20.28|Act.7:10 14:22 20:28]], [[Rom.5.3|Rom.5:3]], [[Eph.3.13|Eph.3:13]], [[1Th.3.3|1Th.3:3]], [[Heb.10.33|Heb.10:33]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Col.1.24|Col.1:24]] θ. τῆς καρδίας, [[2Co.2.4|2Co.2:4]] θ. ἐγείρειν, [[Php.1.17|Php.1:17]]†
_SYN._: ἀνάγκη, διωγμός, στενοχωρία (see supr., and cf. Tr., Syn, iv; Lft., _Notes_, 45) (AS)

G2327.def:
**θεριστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(θερίζω), [in LXX: [[Bel.1.32|Dan LXX Bel 1:32]], Th [[Bel.1.33|Bel 1:33]]* ;]
**a reaper**: [[Mat.13.30, 39|Mat.13:30, 39]]†
(AS)

G2338.def:
**θῆλυς**, -εια, -υ
[in LXX chiefly for נְקֵבָה ;]
**female**: as subst., ἡ θ., **a female, a woman**: [[Rom.1.26-27;|Rom.1:26-27]] τὸ θ.., [[Mat.19.4|Mat.19:4]], [[Mrk.10.6|Mrk.10:6]], [[Gal.3.28|Gal.3:28]].†
(AS)

G2337.def:
**θηλάζω**
(θηλή, a breast), [in LXX chiefly for יָנַק hi. ;]
1. **of the mother, to suckle**: [[Mat.24.19|Mat.24:19]], [[Mrk.13.17|Mrk.13:17]], [[Luk.21.23|Luk.21:23]].
2. **Of the young, to suck**: [[Mat.21.16|Mat.21:16]] μαστούς, [[Luk.11.27|Luk.11:27]] (cf. [[Job.3.12|Job.3:12]], [[Sng.8.1|Sng.8:1]], al.).†
(AS)

G2380.def:
**θύω **
[in LXX chiefly for זָבַח, also for שָׁחַט, etc. ;]
as in c1.;
1. to offer first fruits to a god.
2. **to sacrifice by slaying a victim, offer sacrifice**: [[Act.14.13|Act.14:13]] with dative of person(s), [[Act.14.18|Act.14:18]] id. with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.10.20|1Co.10:20]]
3. **to slay, kill**: [[Jhn.10.10|Jhn.10:10]], [[Act.10.13; 11.7|Act.10:13 11:7]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.15.23, 27; 15.30|Luk.15:23, 27 15:30]]; pass., [[Mat.22.4|Mat.22:4]] τὸ πάσχα ([[Exo.12.21|Exo.12:21]]), [[Mrk.14.12|Mrk.14:12]]; pass., [[Luk.22.7|Luk.22:7]], [[1Co.5.7|1Co.5:7]].†
(AS)

G2360.def:
**θροέω**, -ῶ
(θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX: [[Sng.5.4|Sng.5:4]] (הָמָה * ;]
in cl.,
1. to cry aloud, make an outcry.
2. to utter aloud.
3. In NT (and LXX), pass., **to be troubled, as by an alarm**: [[Mat.24.6|Mat.24:6]], [[Mrk.13.7|Mrk.13:7]], [[Luk.24.37|Luk.24:37]] (WH, mg.), [[2Th.2.2|2Th.2:2]] (cf. Kennedy, _Sources_, 126).†
(AS)

G2330.def:
**θέρος**, -ους, τό
(θέρω, to heat), [in LXX chiefly for קַיִץ ;]
**summer**: [[Mat.24.32|Mat.24:32]], [[Mrk.13.28|Mrk.13:28]], [[Luk.21.30|Luk.21:30]].†
(AS)

G2396.def:
**ἴδε** (Attic ἰδέ; the "later" accentuation is also found in Hom.; Veitch, 215)
1. prop., 2 aor. imperat. of ὁράω, which see
2. **As interjection, apart from the construction of the sentence, and used where one or many are addressed, see! behold! lo!**: [[Mat.25.20, 22; 25.25|Mat.25:20, 22 25:25]], [[Mrk.2.24; 3.34; 11.21; 13.1, 21; 15.4, 35; 16.6|Mrk.2:24 3:34 11:21 13:1, 21 15:4, 35 16:6]], [[Jhn.1.29, 36; 1.48; 3.26; 5.14; 7.26; 11.3, 36; 12.19; 16.29; 18.21; 19.4, 14; 19.26-27|Jhn.1:29, 36 1:48 3:26 5:14 7:26 11:3, 36 12:19 16:29 18:21 19:4, 14 19:26-27]], [[Gal.5.2|Gal.5:2]].†
(AS)

G2351.def:
**θόρυβος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
**a noise, uproar, tumult, as of an excited mob**: [[Mat.26.5; 27.24|Mat.26:5 27:24]], [[Mrk.14.2|Mrk.14:2]], [[Act.20.1; 21.34; 24.18|Act.20:1 21:34 24:18]]; of mourners, = ὄχλος θορυβούμενος, [[Mrk.5.38|Mrk.5:38]]†
(AS)

G2334.def:
**θεωρέω**, -ῶ
(θεωρός, a spectator, θεάομαι) [in LXX chiefly for רָאָה, חָזָה ;] (present and imperfect only, exc. [[Jhn.7.3|Jhn.7:3]] (fut.), [[Mat.28.1|Mat.28:1]], [[Luk.23.48|Luk.23:48]], [[Jhn.8.51|Jhn.8:51]], [[Rev.11.12|Rev.11:12]] (aor.); El., § 24);
1. (cl.), **to look at, gaze, behold**: absol., [[Mat.27.55|Mat.27:55]], [[Mrk.15.40|Mrk.15:40]], [[Luk.23.35|Luk.23:35]]; before πῶς, [[Mrk.12.41|Mrk.12:41]] ποῦ, [[Mrk.15.47|Mrk.15:47]] with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.6.40, 62; 12.45; 16.10-19|Jhn.6:40, 62 12:45 16:10-19]], [[Act.3.16; 20.38; 25.24|Act.3:16 20:38 25:24]], [[Rev.11.11-12|Rev.11:11-12]]; id. with ptcp., [[Mrk.5.15|Mrk.5:15]], [[Luk.10.18|Luk.10:18]], [[Jhn.6.19; 10.12; 20.12, 14|Jhn.6:19 10:12 20:12, 14]], [[1Jn.3.17|1Jn.3:17]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.28.1|Mat.28:1]], [[Luk.14.29; 21.6; 23.48|Luk.14:29 21:6 23:48]], [[Jhn.2.23; 6.2; 7.3|Jhn.2:23 6:2 7:3]], [[Act.4.13; 8.13|Act.4:13 8:13]]; id. with ptcp., [[Jhn.20.6|Jhn.20:6]], [[Act.7.56; 10.11|Act.7:56 10:11]]; before ὅτι, [[Act.19.26|Act.19:26]]
2. In popular lang. (Kennedy, _Sources_, 155; EL, § 24, see word ὁρᾶν), in present and imperfect = ὁράω, **to see, perceive, discern**: before ὅτι, [[Mrk.16.4|Mrk.16:4]], [[Jhn.4.19; 12.19|Jhn.4:19 12:19]], [[Act.19.26; 27.10|Act.19:26 27:10]]; πόσαι, [[Act.21.20|Act.21:20]] πηλίκος, [[Heb.7.4|Heb.7:4]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.5.38|Mrk.5:38]] id. with ptcp., [[Act.17.16; 28.6|Act.17:16 28:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.3.11|Mrk.3:11]], [[Jhn.14.19|Jhn.14:19]], [[Act.9.7; 17.22|Act.9:7 17:22]]; πνεῦμα, [[Luk.24.37|Luk.24:37]] τὸ π., [[Jhn.14.17|Jhn.14:17]] before ὅτι, [[Jhn.9.8|Jhn.9:8]] with ptcp., [[Luk.24.39|Luk.24:39]]
3. **Hebraistically, to experience, partake of**: τ. θάνατον, [[Jhn.8.51|Jhn.8:51]] (cf. [[Psa.89.49|Psa.89:49]]); τ. δόξαν, [[Jhn.17.24|Jhn.17:24]] (cf. ἀνα-, παρα-θερρέω).†
(AS)

**εἰδέα** (Rec. ἰδ-, as in cl.; see Tdf., _Pr._, 81), -ας, ἡ (εἶδον), [in LXX (seel. ἰδ-): [[Gen.5.3|Gen.5:3]] (דְּמוּת), [[Dan.1.13, 15|Da TH 1:13, 15]] (מַרְאֶה), Ep. Jer.63, [[2Ma.3.16|2Ma.3:16]] * ;]

**θυμιάω**, -ῶ
(θύω), [in LXX (with -άζω) chiefly for קָטַר pi., hi. ;]

G2391.def:
**Ἰάρετ** (Rec. -ρέδ, L, Ἰάρεθ), ὁ (Heb. יֶרֶד, LXX Ἰάρεδ, FlJ, Ἰάρεδος),
Jared ([[Gen.5.15|Gen.5:15]]): [[Luk.3.37|Luk.3:37]].†
(AS)

**θραύω **
[in LXX for 1,21 ([[Deu.28.33|Deu.28:33]], [[Isa.42.4; 58.6|Isa.42:4 58:6]]), etc. ;]

**θυμός**, -οῦ, ὁ

[[Col.3.8|Col.3:8]] πικρία κ. θ., [[Eph.4.31|Eph.4:31]] πλησθῆναι, πλήρης θυμοῦ, [[Luk.4.28|Luk.4:28]], [[Act.19.28|Act.19:28]]; θ. ἔχειν, [[Rev.12.12|Rev.12:12]] οἶνος τ. θυμοῦ τ. πορνείας (cf. [[Jer.51.7|Jer.51:7]]), [[Rev.14.8; 18.3|Rev.14:8 18:3]] (cf. [[Rev.17.2|Rev.17:2]]); οἶνος τ. θ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Rev.14.10|Rev.14:10]] τ. ὀργῆς τ. θεοῦ, [[Rev.16.19; 19.15|Rev.16:19 19:15]]; ὁ θ. τ. θεοῦ, [[Rev.14.19; 15.1, 7; 16.1|Rev.14:19 15:1, 7 16:1]]; pl., impulses or outbursts of anger: ἔρις, ζῆλος, θυμοὶ, ἐριθίαι, [[2Co.12.20|2Co.12:20]], [[Gal.5.20|Gal.5:20]] (Cremer, 287, 733).†

(cl.), [[Heb.11.10|Heb.11:10]] [[Rev.21.14, 19|Rev.21:14, 19]]; neut., τὸ θ. (Arist., Phys., vi, 6, 10, LXX and later writers), [[Act.16.26|Act.16:26]] metaphorically, [[Rom.15.20|Rom.15:20]], [[1Co.3.10-12|1Co.3:10-12]] [[Eph.2.20|Eph.2:20]], [[1Ti.6.19|1Ti.6:19]], [[2Ti.2.19|2Ti.2:19]], [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]].†
(AS)

G2322.def:
**θεραπεία**, -ας, ἡ
(θεραπεύω) [in LXX for עֶבֶד [[Gen.45.16|Gen.45:16]] (cf. [[Est.5.2|Est.5:2]]), etc. ;]
1. service.
2. **healing**: [[Luk.9.11|Luk.9:11]] (Field, _Notes_, 60), [[Rev.22.2|Rev.22:2]]
3. **Collective, household attendants, servants**: [[Luk.12.42|Luk.12:42]] (LXX, ll. with).†
(AS)

G2340.def:
**θηρεύω**
(θήρα), [in LXX for צוּד, etc. ;]
**to hunt, ensnare, catch**: metaphorically, [[Luk.11.54|Luk.11:54]]†
(AS)

G2392.def:
**ἴασις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for מַרְפֵּא ;]
**a healing, cure**: [[Act.4.22, 30|Act.4:22, 30]]; pl., [[Luk.13.32|Luk.13:32]]†
_SYN._: see: θεραπεία, 2; ἴαμα, 2 (AS)

G2361.def:
**θρόμβος**, -ου, ὁ
(τρέφω, in primary sense to thicken),
**a lump, a clot of blood **(_DCG_, ii, 685b): αἵματος, [[Luk.22.44|Luk.22:44]] (WH, R, mg. omit the passage, see WH, _App._, 64 ff.).†

G2335.def:
**θεωρία**, -ας, ἡ
(see: θεωρέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 5:7, [[2Ma.5.26|2Ma.5:26]] [[2Mac.15.12|2Mac 15:12]], [[3Ma.5.24|3Ma.5:24]] * ;]
1. a viewing.
2. **= θεώρημα, a spectacle, sight**: [[Luk.23.48|Luk.23:48]] (both senses in cl.).†
(AS)

G2353.def:
**θρέμμα**, -τος, τό
(τρέφω)
1. a nurseling, esp. of animals (Eur., Plat., al.).
2. **cattle**: [[Jhn.4.12|Jhn.4:12]]†
(AS)

G2318.def:
**θεοσεβής**, -ές
(θεός, σέβομαι), [in LXX for אֱלֹהִים יָרֵא, [[Exo.18.21|Exo.18:21]], al. ;]

G2336.def:
**Θήκη**, -ης, ἡ
(τίθημι), [in LXX: [[Exo.25.27|Exo.25:27]] (בַּיִת), [[Isa.6.13; 3.26|Isa.6:13 3:26]] * ;]

(AS)

G2333.def:
**Θευδᾶς**
(perh. contr. from Θεόδωρος, but see MM, _Exp._, xv), -ᾶ, ὁ
**Theudas**: [[Act.5.36|Act.5:36]]†
(AS)

G2371.def:
**θυμομαέω**, -ῶ
(θυμός, μάχομαι),
**to fight desperately, have a hot quarrel**: with dative of person(s), [[Act.12.20|Act.12:20]]†
(AS)

G2304.def:
**θεῖος**, -εία, -εῖον
(θεός), [in LXX: [[Exo.31.3; 35.31|Exo.31:3 35:31]], [[Job.27.3; 33.4|Job.27:3 33:4]], [[Pro.2.17|Pro.2:17]] (אֵל, אֱלֹהִים, אֱלוֹהַּ), [[Sir.6.35, 1-37|Sir.6:35, 1-37]] II [[Mal.3.1-40|Mal.3:1-40]], [[3Ma.1.1-29|3Ma.1:1-29]], 4Mac.25 * ;]
**divine**: δύναμις, [[2Pe.1.3|2Pe.1:3]] φύσις (for parallel in π., see MM, _Exp._, xv), [[2Pe.1.4|2Pe.1:4]] τὸ θ.,

(AS)

G2302.def:
**θέατρον**, -ον, τό
(θεάομαι),
1. **a theatre **(used also as a place of assembly): [[Act.19.29, 31|Act.19:29, 31]].
2. Collective for οἱ θεαταί, the spectators.
3. **= θέα, θέαμα, a spectacle, show**: metaphorically, [[1Co.4.9|1Co.4:9]]†
(AS)

G2376.def:
**θυρίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
(dim, of θύρα), [in LXX chiefly for חַלּוֹן ;]
**a window**: [[Act.20.9|Act.20:9]], [[2Co.11.33|2Co.11:33]].†
(AS)

G2356.def:
**θρησκεία** (-κία, T), -ας, ἡ
(θρῆσκος), [in LXX: [[Wis.14.18, 27|Wis.14:18, 27]], [[Sir.22.5|Sir.22:5]] A, [[4Ma.5.6|4Ma.5:6]] [[4Mac.5.13|4Mac 5:13]] * ;]
religion in its external aspect (MM, _Exp._, xv), **worship**: [[Act.26.5|Act.26:5]], [[Jas.1.26-27|Jas.1:26-27]]; θ. τῶν ἀγγέλων, [[Col.2.18|Col.2:18]]†
_SYN._: see: θρῆσκος (AS)

G2305.def:
**θειότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(θεῖος) [in LXX: [[Wis.18.9|Wis.18:9]] * ;]
**divine nature, divinity**: [[Rom.1.20|Rom.1:20]] (for ex. from π., see MM, _Exp._, xv).†
_SYN._: θεότης, deity, godhead, divine personality. θει. = divine nature and properties, a summary term for the attributes of deity, differing from θεότης as quality or attribute from essence (AS)

G2319.def:
**θεοστυγής**, -ές
(θεός, στυγέω),
1. passive, as frequently in cl., **hateful to God**: [[Rom.1.30|Rom.1:30]] (R, txt., cf. Lit., _Notes_, 256).
2. **Active, hating God**: lb. (R, mg., cf. _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G2339.def:
**θήρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for צַיִד, טָרַף, רֶשֶׁת, and cogn. forms ;]
1. a hunting, chase (Hat., Xen., al.).
2. prey, game (c1.).
3. As in [[Psa.35.8|Psa.35:8]] = רֶשֶׁת, **a net**: [[Rom.11.9|Rom.11:9]] (but see Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G2386.def:
**ἴαμα**, -τος, τό
(ἰάομαι), [in LXX for מַרְפֵּא ([[2Ch.36.16|2Ch.36:16]], [[Ecc.10.4|Ecc.10:4]], [[Jer.33.6|Jer.33:6]], etc. ;]
1. most frequently in cl., a means of healing, remedy (Thuc., al.; [[Wis.11.4; 10.9|Wis.11:4 10:9]]).
2. = ἴασις (which see), **a healing **(Plat.; Jer, l.with): pl., [[1Co.12.9; 12.28; 12.30|1Co.12:9 12:28 12:30]].†
(AS)

G2341.def:
**θηριομαχέω**, -ῶ
(θηρίον, μάχομαι),
**to fight with wild beasts **(Diod., al.): [[1Co.15.32|1Co.15:32]]†
(AS)

G2358.def:
**θριαμβεύω**
(θρίαμβος, 1. a festal hymn to Bacchus. 2. The Roman triumphus),
1. to triumph (and rarely, with accusative, to triumph over; so perh. [[Col.2.15|Col.2:15]], but see infr.).
2. **to lead in triumph**: with accusative of person(s), [[2Co.2.14|2Co.2:14]] hence, generally, **to make a spectacle or show of**: [[Col.2.15|Col.2:15]] (but see supr.; cf. MM, _Exp._, xv; and esp. Field, _Notes_, 181).†
(AS)

G2382.def:
**θώραξ**, -ακσς, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁרְיוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
**a breastplate**: [[Rev.9.9, 17|Rev.9:9, 17]]; θ. τ. δικαιοσύνης, [[Eph.6.14|Eph.6:14]] (cf. [[Isa.59.17|Isa.59:17]], [[Wis.5.18-19|Wis.5:18-19]]); θ. πίστεως, [[1Th.5.8|1Th.5:8]]†
(AS)

G2375.def:
**θυρεός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(θύρα), [in LXX for מָגֵן, צִנָּה ;]
1. in Hom., a door-stone.
2. In late Gk. (Polyb., Plut.), **the scutum, a large oblong shield**: θ. τ. πίστεως, [[Eph.6.16|Eph.6:16]] (cf. [[Wis.5.20|Wis.5:20]], where ὁσιότης is likened to the ἀσπίς, the clypeus or small round shield of the light-armed soldier).†
(AS)

G2345.def:
**θιγγάνω **
[in LXX for נָגַע, [[Exo.19.12|Exo.19:12]] * ;]
1. **to touch, handle**: [[Col.2.21|Col.2:21]], [[Heb.12.20|Heb.12:20]]" (LXX) .
2. **to injure **(like _Heb._ נָגַע, and as in Eur., Iph. Aul., 1351): with genitive, [[Heb.11.28|Heb.11:28]]†
_SYN._: see: ἅπτω (AS)

G2324.def:
**θεράπων**, -οντος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עֶבֶד ;]
**an attendant, servant**: [[Heb.3.5|Heb.3:5]] (LXX)
_SYN._: see: διάκονος (AS)

G2369.def:
**θυμιατήριον**, -ου, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX: [[2Ch.26.19|2Ch.26:19]], [[Ezk.8.11|Eze.8:11]] (קְטֹרֶת), [[4Ma.7.11|4Ma.7:11]] * ;]
1. as in cl. (Hdt., iv, 162; Thuc., vi, 46) and LXX, **a censer**: [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]] (but see infr., and cf. Westc., in l).
2. As in Philo., rer. div., § 46, FlJ, _Ant._, iv, 2, 4, al., the altar of incense: He, l.with (but see supr. and cf. MM, _Exp._, xv).†
(AS)

G2301.def:
**θεατρίζω**
(θέατρον),
**to make a spectacle of, expose to contempt **(eccl.; ἐκθ-, Polyb.): pass., [[Heb.10.33|Heb.10:33]]†
(AS)

G2366.def:
**θύελλα**, -ης, ἡ
(θύω), [in LXX [[Deu.4.11; 5.22|Deu.4:11 5:22]] (עֲרָפֶל), [[Exo.10.22|Exo.10:22]] * ;] (poët. in cl.),
**a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind**: [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]]†
_SYN._: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)

G2357.def:
**θρῆσκος**
(-κός, WH), -ον, ό
religious, careful of the outward forms of divine service (see previous word)): [[Jas.1.26|Jas.1:26]]†
_SYN._: εὐσεβής, θεοσεβής, δεισιδαίμων (see Tr., _Syn._, § xlviii) (AS)

G2393.def:
**ἴασπις**, -ιδος, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Exo.28.18; 36.38|Exo.28:18 36:38]] ([[Exo.39.11|Exo.39:11]]) (יַהֲלֹם), [[Isa.54.12|Isa.54:12]] (כַּדְכֹּד), [[Ezk.28.13|Eze.28:13]] (יָשְׁפֵה, see B_DB_, _Lex._, see word)* ;]
**jasper, apparently not the modern stone of that name, but a translucent stone **(_DB_, see word): [[Rev.4.3; 21.11, 18-19|Rev.4:3 21:11, 18-19]].†
(AS)

G2367.def:
**θύινος** (usually θύϊνος, as Rec.), -η, -ον
(θυία, θύα, an African aromatic tree, with ornamentally veined wood of varying colour, = Lat. citrinus), [in Sm.: [[1Ki.10.11|3Ki.10:11]] (אַלְמֻגִּים)* ;]
**thyme**: ξύλον, [[Rev.18.12|Rev.18:12]] (Diosc.).†
(AS)
